paragraphs.text: CISA's addition of ten actively exploited vulnerabilities to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog elevates remediation expectations while critical flaws in Drupal core and government visa systems are under active exploitation. Concurrent breaches of the US Air Force Cloud One platform and multiple national immigration portals indicate systemic cloud identity and access control weaknesses that demand immediate assurance review.

Supply chain incidents involving a Microsoft Store application delivering a remote access trojan and SAP's detection of suspicious activity in its IT environment reveal gaps in third-party software integrity and supplier incident notification. Control owners should prioritize application allowlisting validation and contractual breach notification assurances.
